user_report: Battery plus goes to Q1; Q1.L reaches H-bridge pin4 VDD. VBAT is not directly connected to VDD.
interpretation: Separate copper nets across a semiconductor; not a claim of complete electrical isolation or a diode-mode result.

candidate_q1.status: R1A marking matches Formosa FMOS3401A datasheet p5; SOT-23 PMOS with G=1 (photo R), S=2 (photo L), D=3 (photo single S). Candidate identification, not manufacturer proof. Drain at battery+ and source at load support reverse-polarity protection; gate-control behavior not verified. Earlier MMBT3904 NPN hypothesis withdrawn.

retained_hypotheses: TP14 battery-side copper is photo-supported; latest user report explicitly probes the battery/Q1/output path.
Other inferred gate-control and sensing branches are not certified by this correction.
additional_user_reports: V035 is connected to VREF TP
V042 is connected to VDD TP
User authorizes naming the unlabelled Q1-output rail VSYS.
L1/L2 are connected to the same VSYS.
confirmed_existing_net: V042-PIC20 VDD-C32.1 is confirmed to TP103 VDD; no new net merge.
naming_policy: User requested the printed labels BATTERY (+/-), VDD, VREF and GND, then explicitly authorized naming the unlabelled post-Q1 supply. VSYS is that new name: Q1.L/native2, MX512H pin4, L1 and L2 supply sides. Battery (-) is on GND.
l1_l2_confirmation: v0.9.9: User confirms L1 and L2 connect to the same VSYS after Q1. Existing supply-side pad1 selections retained from photos/model; opposite terminals are separate across each component. The report does not identify inductance/ferrite type or measured values.
